sentences.en: I'm fully in the camp of C++ is not a strongly typed language, and we jump through a lot of hoops to try to make it more strongly typed.

sentences.en: We delete problematic overloads.

sentences.en: We write templates that are constrained in specific ways.
sentences.zh: 我们编写带有特定约束的模板。

sentences.en: We say, I mean, like we teach single parameter or variadic constructors or constructors with default arguments.
sentences.zh: 我们说，我的意思是，比如我们教单参数或变长参数构造函数，或者带默认参数的构造函数。

sentences.en: Pretty much every constructor at this point needs to be explicit.
sentences.zh: 可以说现在几乎每个构造函数都需要是 explicit（显式）的。

sentences.en: All of these things come down to implicit conversions that make the language less strongly typed.
sentences.zh: 所有这些最终都归结为隐式转换，从而让这门语言的强类型特性减弱。
